words.enDefinition: the part of a shop where customers browse merchandise

examples.en: I checked the shop floor before asking a member of staff for help.
examples.zh: 我先在「门店销售区」找了一圈，才请店员帮忙。

examples.en: Only one lamp was left on the shop floor by late afternoon.
examples.zh: 到了傍晚前，「门店销售区」只剩下一盏台灯。

collocations: bring something onto the shop floor

words.enDefinition: a sign or guide listing stores and where to find them

examples.en: The store directory by the entrance showed a shoe shop on level two.
examples.zh: 入口处的「商场店铺导览」显示二楼有一家鞋店。

examples.en: I checked the store directory while my roommate looked for the escalator.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商场店铺导览」，室友在找自动扶梯。

collocations: look up a shop in the store directory

words.enDefinition: the part of a shop selling things used in the home

examples.en: I found the kettle in the homeware section next to the stationery.
examples.zh: 我在文具旁边的「家居用品区」找到了水壶。

examples.en: We walked through the homeware section to compare bowls for our flat.
examples.zh: 我们去了「家居用品区」，想给合租房挑几个碗。

words.enDefinition: the area of a store that sells men's clothing

examples.en: The menswear department was on the same floor as the fitting rooms.
examples.zh: 「男装部」和试衣间在同一层。

examples.en: I asked the staff in the menswear department where to find interview clothes.
examples.zh: 我问「男装部」的店员到哪里找面试穿的衣服。

words.enDefinition: the area of a large store where shoes are sold

examples.en: The shoe department was at the back of the store near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「鞋类区」在店铺后面，靠近楼梯。

examples.en: I compared two pairs in the shoe department after looking at the display.
examples.zh: 看完展示后，我在「鞋类区」对比了两双鞋。

words.enDefinition: a display of products at the end of a store aisle

examples.en: The towels were on an end-of-aisle display rather than along the wall.
examples.zh: 毛巾摆在「过道尽头的陈列台」上，沿墙的货架上没有。

examples.en: I walked past the end-of-aisle display before I spotted the kitchen shelves.
examples.zh: 我经过「过道尽头的陈列台」后，才看到摆厨房用品的货架。

words.enDefinition: a sign identifying a numbered or labelled store aisle

examples.en: I checked the aisle marker after the assistant told me to look for twelve.
examples.zh: 店员让我找十二号过道，我就看了「过道编号牌」。

examples.en: The aisle marker was easier to see once I had passed the display.
examples.zh: 经过展台后，「过道编号牌」就更容易看见了。

words.enDefinition: a stand or rail used to hang clothes for sale

examples.en: I put the blue jacket back on the clothing rack near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我把那件蓝夹克放回入口旁的「服装挂架」。

examples.en: The clothing rack by the window held several styles of winter coats.
examples.zh: 窗边的「服装挂架」上挂着几款冬大衣。

collocations: hang something on a clothing rack

words.enDefinition: a table used to show products to people in a shop

examples.en: The folded sweatshirts were on a display table beside the front window.
examples.zh: 叠好的卫衣放在橱窗旁的「商品陈列台」上。

examples.en: I put the folded shirt back on the display table before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，我把叠好的衬衫放回了「商品陈列台」。

collocations: arrange items on a display table
a display table by the entrance

words.enDefinition: a tag on a shelf identifying the product kept there

examples.en: I read the shelf label to check that I had the right notebook.
examples.zh: 我看了「货架标签」，确认拿的是我要找的笔记本。

examples.en: The larger boxes were blocking the shelf label for the USB cables.
examples.zh: 那些大盒子挡住了 USB 线的「货架标签」。

collocations: match a product to its shelf label

words.enDefinition: the highest surface in a set of shelves

examples.en: The only red umbrella was on the top shelf above the backpacks.
examples.zh: 唯一一把红伞在背包上方「最上层货架」上。

examples.en: Could you get the small blue box from the top shelf for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我从「最上层货架」拿下那个小蓝盒吗？

collocations: put something on the top shelf

words.enDefinition: the lowest surface in a set of shelves

examples.en: I checked the bottom shelf after noticing that the sign pointed down.
examples.zh: 看到标牌上的箭头朝下，我就看了「最下层货架」。

examples.en: The larger storage boxes were kept on the bottom shelf near the till.
examples.zh: 大一点的收纳盒放在收银台旁边的「最下层货架」上。

collocations: store boxes on the bottom shelf

words.enDefinition: on the employee side of a retail counter

examples.en: The spare headphones were kept behind the counter in a small cabinet.
examples.zh: 备用耳机放在「柜台后面」的小柜子里。

examples.en: The sign said the batteries were behind the counter by the entrance.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着，电池在入口处的「柜台后面」。

collocations: an item stored behind the counter

words.enDefinition: a room in a shop where extra products are stored

examples.en: The assistant went to the stockroom to look for a second pair.
examples.zh: 店员去了「门店储货间」，看看还有没有第二双。

examples.en: The stockroom was at the back of the shop past the fitting rooms.
examples.zh: 经过试衣间往店铺后面走，就是「门店储货间」。

words.enDefinition: a sample product set out for customers to look at or handle

examples.en: The assistant showed me the display model before fetching a boxed kettle.
examples.zh: 店员先给我看了「陈列样机」，然后去拿盒装的新水壶。

examples.en: The display model felt lighter than the one I already had at home.
examples.zh: 这台「陈列样机」拿起来比我家里那台更轻。

words.enDefinition: a sample shoppers can use to try a product before buying

examples.en: I found a tester next to the sealed hand creams on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我在货架上还没拆封的护手霜旁找到了「门店试用装」。

examples.en: The assistant pointed to the tester so I could smell the fragrance.
examples.zh: 店员指了指「门店试用装」，让我可以闻一下香味。

words.enDefinition: to handle or operate a model on display before buying

examples.en: I asked if I could try the demo before picking a keyboard.
examples.zh: 我挑键盘前问能不能「试用演示样机」。

examples.en: The store assistant invited me to try the demo beside the headphone shelf.
examples.zh: 店员请我「试用耳机货架旁的演示样机」。

collocations: invite someone to try the demo

words.enDefinition: the one remaining piece of a product on display

examples.en: I picked up the last one on the shelf and checked the box.
examples.zh: 我拿起「架上剩下的最后一件」，看了看包装盒。

examples.en: The student asked whether the last one on the shelf had been reserved.
examples.zh: 那名学生问「架上剩下的最后一件」是不是被预留了。

collocations: take the last one on the shelf
check the last one on the shelf
buy the last one on the shelf

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a shop sells a particular brand

examples.en: “Do you carry this brand?” I asked, showing the label on my bottle.
examples.zh: 我给店员看了瓶子上的标签，问「你们有卖这个牌子吗？」

examples.en: I showed the assistant a photo and asked, “Do you carry this brand?”
examples.zh: 我给店员看了张照片，问「你们有卖这个牌子吗？」

collocations: “Do you carry this brand in store?”
“Do you carry this brand anywhere nearby?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking which store aisle contains an item

examples.en: “Which aisle is it in?” I asked when we couldn't find the soap.
examples.zh: 我们找不到香皂，我就问「它在几号过道？」

examples.en: The clerk said they had folders, so I asked, “Which aisle is it in?”
examples.zh: 店员说有文件夹，我就问「它在几号过道？」

collocations: “Which aisle is it in at this branch?”

words.expression: do you have any more in the back
words.lemma: do you have any more in the back
words.enDefinition: a question asking whether extra items are kept off the shop floor
acceptedEnVariants: do you have any more in the back

examples.en: The shelf was almost empty, so I asked, “Do you have any more in the back?”
examples.zh: 货架几乎空了，我便问「备货间还有吗？」

examples.en: “Do you have any more in the back?” my roommate asked at the till.
examples.zh: 室友在收银台问「备货间还有吗？」

collocations: ask “Do you have any more in the back?”
“Do you have any more in the back unopened?”
“Do you have any more in the back at this store?”

words.enDefinition: a question checking whether any other units are available

examples.en: “Is this the last one?” I asked after noticing a dent in the box.
examples.zh: 我看到盒子有个凹痕，就问「这是最后一件吗？」

examples.en: I held up the lamp and asked the assistant, “Is this the last one?”
examples.zh: 我拿起台灯问店员「这是最后一件吗？」

collocations: “Is this the last one on display?”
“Is this the last one in this colour?”

words.enDefinition: shown for customers to look at rather than offered for sale

examples.en: The small sign said the red coffee maker was on display only.
examples.zh: 小标牌写着，红色咖啡机「仅供展示」。

examples.en: I asked about the chairs marked on display only near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我问了入口旁标着「仅供展示」的那几把椅子。

words.enDefinition: more units of a product expected in the shop soon

examples.en: The assistant said there was more stock coming in later that week.
examples.zh: 店员说那周晚些时候「还有一批货会到」。

examples.en: I asked about more stock coming in before our next club meeting.
examples.zh: 我问下次社团开会前是不是「还有一批货会到」。

collocations: ask about more stock coming in

words.enDefinition: to look for the item or its availability at another location

examples.en: Could you check another branch before I make the trip across town?
examples.zh: 我跑一趟城另一头之前，你能「查一下别的门店」吗？

examples.en: The assistant offered to check another branch for a black backpack.
examples.zh: 店员说可以「查一下别的门店」有没有黑色双肩包。

collocations: ask staff to check another branch
check another branch for a different size

words.enDefinition: a small container carried around a shop while choosing goods

examples.en: I grabbed a shopping basket because I was buying only a few things.
examples.zh: 我只买几样东西，就拿了个「手提购物篮」。

examples.en: I left the empty shopping basket beside the stack near the door.
examples.zh: 我把空的「手提购物篮」放回门边那摞篮子旁。

collocations: put something in your shopping basket

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a register is serving shoppers

examples.en: “Is this checkout open?” I asked when the cashier glanced up at me.
examples.zh: 收银员抬头看我时，我问「这台收银台开着吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, “Is this checkout open?” while I held our shopping basket.
examples.zh: 我提着我们的购物篮时，朋友问「这台收银台开着吗？」

words.expression: can I see one out of the box
words.lemma: can i see one out of the box
words.enDefinition: a question asking staff to show an unpackaged example
acceptedEnVariants: can I see one out of the box

examples.en: I pointed to the boxed lamps and asked, “Can I see one out of the box?”
examples.zh: 我指着盒装台灯问「能拿一件出来看看吗？」

examples.en: “Can I see one out of the box?” she asked before choosing a kettle.
examples.zh: 她挑水壶前问「能拿一件出来看看吗？」

collocations: ask “Can I see one out of the box?”
“Can I see one out of the box before I decide?”
“Can I see one out of the box here?”

words.enDefinition: a response saying you want to browse the shop first

examples.en: “I'll have a look around,” I said when the assistant offered to help.
examples.zh: 店员主动提供帮助时，我说「我先自己逛逛」。

examples.en: My friend answered, “I'll have a look around,” and headed toward the shelves.
examples.zh: 朋友回答「我先自己逛逛」，然后朝货架走去。

collocations: “I'll have a look around and come back”

words.enDefinition: the employee who manages entry to a store's fitting rooms

examples.en: The fitting room attendant counted my items before showing me a cubicle.
examples.zh: 「试衣间服务员」先数了我要试的衣服，然后指给我一个隔间。

examples.en: I asked the fitting room attendant where to leave the clothes I didn't want.
examples.zh: 我问「试衣间服务员」不想买的衣服要放在哪里。

collocations: show your items to the fitting room attendant
speak with a fitting room attendant

words.expression: how many items can I take in
words.lemma: how many items can i take in
words.enDefinition: a question about the number of items allowed in a fitting room
acceptedEnVariants: how many items can I take in

examples.en: I held up the jackets and asked, “How many items can I take in?”
examples.zh: 我举起几件夹克，问「我能带几件进去试穿？」

examples.en: “How many items can I take in?” she asked at the fitting room entrance.
examples.zh: 她在试衣间入口问「我能带几件进去试穿？」

collocations: ask “How many items can I take in?”
“How many items can I take in at once?”
“How many items can I take in with me?”

words.enDefinition: to get an item of another size for me to try

examples.en: Could you bring me a different size when you get a chance?
examples.zh: 你有空时能「帮我拿另一个尺码」吗？

examples.en: I asked the attendant to bring me a different size of the same jacket.
examples.zh: 我请服务员「帮我拿同款夹克的另一个尺码」。

collocations: could you bring me a different size
ask someone to bring me a different size
bring me a different size of this style

words.enDefinition: fitting about as expected for the standard size on the label

examples.en: These shoes feel true to size compared with the pair I wore in.
examples.zh: 和我穿来的那双相比，这双鞋的「尺码符合预期」。

examples.en: The assistant said the jacket was generally true to size for this brand.
examples.zh: 店员说，这个牌子的这款夹克「尺码通常符合预期」。

collocations: a style that is true to size

words.enDefinition: to fit smaller than the stated size would usually suggest

examples.en: These trousers run small, so I want to try the next size up.
examples.zh: 这款裤子「尺码偏小」，我想试大一码。

examples.en: I asked whether the boots tend to run small in this brand.
examples.zh: 我问这个牌子的靴子是不是普遍「尺码偏小」。

words.enDefinition: to fit larger than the stated size would usually suggest

examples.en: The assistant said the shirts run large compared with last year's cut.
examples.zh: 店员说，这款衬衫比去年的版型「尺码偏大」。

examples.en: These jeans run large on me even though I usually buy this size.
examples.zh: 我通常买这个尺码，可穿这款牛仔裤还是觉得「尺码偏大」。

collocations: a style that can run large

words.enDefinition: to choose a larger size than the one first considered

examples.en: I usually size up when I buy a jacket to wear over sweaters.
examples.zh: 买夹克打算套在毛衣外面时，我通常「选大一码」。

examples.en: The attendant asked whether I wanted to size up in that style.
examples.zh: 服务员问我这款要不要「选大一码」。

collocations: size up for a looser fit

words.enDefinition: to choose a smaller size than the one first considered

examples.en: I decided to size down after trying the two jackets side by side.
examples.zh: 把两件夹克都试过以后，我决定「选小一码」。

examples.en: The jumper already felt loose, so I wanted to see what happened if I did size down.
examples.zh: 这件套头衫已经有些松了，我想看看「选小一码」效果如何。

collocations: size down for a closer fit

words.enDefinition: fitting somewhere between two standard sizes for an item

examples.en: I'm between sizes in these jeans, so neither pair feels quite right.
examples.zh: 这款牛仔裤我「介于两个尺码之间」，两条穿起来都不太合适。

examples.en: The assistant said I might be between sizes in this particular style.
examples.zh: 店员说，就这款来说，我可能「介于两个尺码之间」。

words.enDefinition: a standard cut with a moderate amount of extra room

examples.en: I tried the regular fit before comparing it with the slimmer jacket.
examples.zh: 我先试穿了「常规版型」，再和更修身的夹克比较。

examples.en: The trousers in regular fit had enough room for me to sit comfortably.
examples.zh: 「常规版型」的裤子有足够余量，坐着也舒服。

words.enDefinition: a cut that sits closer to the body than standard clothing

examples.en: The assistant brought a slim fit shirt for me to compare with mine.
examples.zh: 店员拿来一件「修身版型」的衬衫，让我和自己那件对比。

examples.en: I preferred the slim fit until I tried reaching over my head.
examples.zh: 我原本更喜欢「修身版型」，试着把手举过头顶后就改主意了。

words.enDefinition: a cut that provides extra room for comfort and movement

examples.en: The relaxed fit felt better when I lifted my arms in the mirror.
examples.zh: 我对着镜子抬了抬胳膊，觉得「宽松版型」穿着更舒服。

examples.en: The clerk showed me jeans with a relaxed fit through the hips.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了一条臀部采用「宽松版型」的牛仔裤。

collocations: a relaxed fit through the hips

words.enDefinition: a deliberately large cut intended to look loose on the body

examples.en: I liked the oversized fit until I saw how far the sleeves hung.
examples.zh: 我本来喜欢这种「廓形偏大的版型」，后来发现袖子垂得太长。

examples.en: The sweatshirt had an oversized fit even in my usual size.
examples.zh: 这件卫衣就算买我平时的尺码，也是「廓形偏大的版型」。

words.enDefinition: clothing sizes proportioned for shorter people

examples.en: I tried petite sizing after finding the regular trousers too long again.
examples.zh: 常规版的裤子又太长了，我便试了「小个子尺码」。

examples.en: The store assistant showed me where they kept jackets in petite sizing.
examples.zh: 店员指给我看「小个子尺码」的夹克放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: clothing sizes proportioned for people taller than average

examples.en: I asked about tall sizing because the sleeves stopped above my wrists.
examples.zh: 袖子短到手腕上方，我就问有没有「高个子尺码」。

examples.en: The shop stocked two coat styles in tall sizing on the upstairs rail.
examples.zh: 楼上的挂架上有两款「高个子尺码」的大衣。

collocations: check whether tall sizing is available

words.enDefinition: the distance from the crotch seam to the lower edge of a trouser leg

examples.en: The attendant checked the inseam length before bringing me another pair of trousers.
examples.zh: 服务员先看了「裤腿内侧长度」，然后给我拿了另一条裤子。

examples.en: I wrote down the inseam length after finding a pair that fit.
examples.zh: 找到合身的裤子后，我记下了它的「裤腿内侧长度」。

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the waist

examples.en: I used my waist measurement to choose between two pairs of jeans.
examples.zh: 我根据自己的「腰围尺寸」在两条牛仔裤里挑了一条。

examples.en: The assistant checked my waist measurement before suggesting another pair of trousers.
examples.zh: 店员先核对了我的「腰围尺寸」，再推荐另一条裤子。

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the chest

examples.en: I checked my chest measurement before choosing a jacket for the interview.
examples.zh: 选面试要穿的夹克前，我先量了自己的「胸围尺寸」。

examples.en: The clerk asked for my chest measurement before suggesting a size to try.
examples.zh: 店员先问了我的「胸围尺寸」，再建议我试哪个尺码。

words.enDefinition: fitting too closely across the shoulder area

examples.en: The blouse felt tight across the shoulders when I reached for my bag.
examples.zh: 我伸手去够包时，觉得衬衫「肩部紧绷」。

examples.en: I told the attendant it was tight across the shoulders but fine elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我告诉服务员，这件衣服「肩部紧绷」，其他地方都合适。

words.enDefinition: having more room than wanted around the waist

examples.en: The trousers were loose around the waist even with my usual belt.
examples.zh: 这条裤子就算系上我平时用的皮带也「腰部偏松」。

examples.en: I showed my friend how loose around the waist the skirt was.
examples.zh: 我给朋友看了看这条裙子「腰部有多松」。

words.enDefinition: having trouser legs that extend farther than desired

examples.en: The jeans fitted at the waist but were too long in the leg.
examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤腰部合适，但「裤腿太长」。

examples.en: I said the trousers were too long in the leg even with boots.
examples.zh: 我说就算穿靴子，这条裤子也还是「裤腿太长」。

collocations: be too long in the leg
slightly too long in the leg
trousers that are too long in the leg

words.enDefinition: fitting slightly closer than you would like

examples.en: The shoes felt a little snug after I stood in them.
examples.zh: 我穿着这双鞋站起来后，觉得它们「稍微有点紧」。

examples.en: I told the assistant the cardigan was a little snug across my chest.
examples.zh: 我告诉店员，这件开衫胸口「稍微有点紧」。

collocations: be a little snug at first
a little snug around the toes

words.enDefinition: enough extra space to move comfortably in clothing

examples.en: I bent my elbows to see if the jacket gave me room to move.
examples.zh: 我弯了弯胳膊，看看这件夹克有没有足够的「活动余量」。

examples.en: The larger shirt gave me room to move without pulling at the sleeves.
examples.zh: 大一点的那件衬衫有「活动余量」，动起来袖子不会被拉扯。

collocations: have plenty of room to move

words.enDefinition: enough space under a garment to wear other clothes

examples.en: I wanted room to layer a thick jumper under my new coat.
examples.zh: 我想让新大衣有足够的「叠穿余量」，里面能穿一件厚毛衣。

examples.en: This size gave me room to layer without leaving the shoulders too loose.
examples.zh: 这个尺码给我留了「叠穿余量」，肩膀也不会太松。

words.enDefinition: extra space between a waistband and the body

examples.en: I noticed a gap at the waist when I turned sideways to the mirror.
examples.zh: 我侧身照镜子时，发现「腰部有一处空隙」。

examples.en: The smaller pair reduced the gap at the waist without feeling uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 小一码的那条把「腰部空隙」缩小了，穿着也没觉得难受。

collocations: notice a gap at the waist
a small gap at the waist
trousers with a gap at the waist

words.enDefinition: to be stretched tightly over the chest when worn

examples.en: I felt the shirt pull across the chest when I buttoned it.
examples.zh: 我扣上扣子，就觉得这件衬衫「胸前绷紧了」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the jacket would pull across the chest with a sweater underneath.
examples.zh: 店员问里面套件毛衣后，这件夹克会不会「胸前被绷紧」。

collocations: start to pull across the chest
clothes that pull across the chest
pull across the chest when closed

words.enDefinition: the part of a shoe that surrounds the toes

examples.en: The toe box felt cramped when I stood up in the new shoes.
examples.zh: 穿着新鞋站起来时，我觉得「鞋头里面」很挤。

examples.en: I asked whether the other pair had more room in the toe box.
examples.zh: 我问另外那双的「鞋头内部空间」是不是更宽敞。

words.enDefinition: a shoe fit with extra space across the foot

examples.en: The assistant suggested a wide fit after I tried the regular pair.
examples.zh: 试过普通版后，店员建议我试试「宽楦版鞋」。

examples.en: I found a wide fit in the same style at the other shop.
examples.zh: 我在另一家店找到了同款的「宽楦版鞋」。

words.enDefinition: movement of the heel up and down inside a shoe

examples.en: I noticed some heel slip when I took a few steps.
examples.zh: 我走了几步，发现鞋子有些「鞋跟不跟脚」。

examples.en: The second pair felt better, with less heel slip as I walked.
examples.zh: 第二双穿起来感觉更好，走路时「鞋跟没那么容易滑脱」。

words.enDefinition: to cause friction at the back of my foot

examples.en: The boots began to rub against my heel after a few steps.
examples.zh: 走了几步，这双靴子就开始「磨我的脚后跟」。

examples.en: I could feel the stiff edge rub against my heel as I walked.
examples.zh: 我走路时能感觉鞋边硬硬的，「磨我的脚后跟」。

collocations: start to rub against my heel
seem to rub against my heel
feel the shoe rub against my heel

words.enDefinition: to take a few steps while wearing the shoes being tried

examples.en: The assistant suggested I walk around in them before choosing a size.
examples.zh: 店员建议我先「穿着它们走一走」，再选尺码。

examples.en: Can I walk around in them to see how the soles feel?
examples.zh: 我能「穿着它们走一走」，感受一下鞋底吗？

collocations: try to walk around in them
ask if you can walk around in them
walk around in them for a minute

words.enDefinition: to put on both shoes in a pair to test the fit

examples.en: I asked whether I could try both shoes on before paying.
examples.zh: 我问付款前能不能「两只鞋都试穿」。

examples.en: The shop assistant brought the full pair so I could try both shoes on.
examples.zh: 店员拿来了一整双，让我能「两只鞋都试穿」。

collocations: ask to try both shoes on
let a customer try both shoes on

words.expression: can I try this over my shirt
words.lemma: can i try this over my shirt
words.zhGloss: 我可以套在衬衫外面试吗
words.enDefinition: a question asking whether to try a garment over a shirt
acceptedZhAnswers: 我可以套在衬衫外面试吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I try this over my shirt

examples.en: “Can I try this over my shirt?” I asked, holding up the jacket.
examples.zh: 我拿起夹克问「我可以套在衬衫外面试吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, “Can I try this over my shirt?” by the coat rack.
examples.zh: 朋友站在大衣架旁问「我可以套在衬衫外面试吗？」

collocations: ask “Can I try this over my shirt?”
“Can I try this over my shirt here?”
“Can I try this over my shirt first?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking how well the item fits the person wearing it

examples.en: “How's the fit?” the attendant asked as I stepped out of the fitting room.
examples.zh: 我从试衣间出来时，服务员问「穿着合身吗？」

examples.en: My roommate looked up from her phone and asked, “How's the fit?”
examples.zh: 室友从手机上抬起头，问「穿着合身吗？」

collocations: “How's the fit compared with the other pair?”

words.enDefinition: a question about whether any part of a shoe squeezes the foot

examples.en: “Does it pinch anywhere?” the assistant asked when I took the first step.
examples.zh: 我迈出第一步时，店员问「有没有哪里夹脚？」

examples.en: My friend watched me try the boot and asked, “Does it pinch anywhere?”
examples.zh: 朋友看我试靴子，问「有没有哪里夹脚？」

collocations: “Does it pinch anywhere when you walk?”
“Does it pinch anywhere near your toes?”

words.enDefinition: a shoe size between two adjacent whole-number sizes

examples.en: I asked whether the trainers came in a half size above these.
examples.zh: 我问这款运动鞋有没有比这双大「半码」的。

examples.en: The assistant brought a half size up because my toes touched the front.
examples.zh: 我的脚趾顶到鞋头，店员给我拿了一双「大半码」的。

words.enDefinition: a checkout run by a cashier rather than by customers

examples.en: I chose a staffed checkout because my umbrella had no barcode on it.
examples.zh: 我的伞上没有条码，所以我去了「人工收银台」。

examples.en: The sign pointed towards a staffed checkout at the end of the aisle.
examples.zh: 标牌指向过道尽头的一个「人工收银台」。

collocations: a staffed checkout near the exit

words.enDefinition: a passage leading to a particular register in a store

examples.en: I switched to the next checkout lane when the cashier waved me over.
examples.zh: 收银员挥手让我过去，我便换到了旁边的「收银通道」。

examples.en: The closest checkout lane was already full by the time we reached it.
examples.zh: 我们到最近的「收银通道」时，那里已经排满了人。

words.enDefinition: a light showing whether a checkout lane is serving customers

examples.en: I saw the checkout light turn green just before I reached the queue.
examples.zh: 我刚走到队伍旁，就看见「收银通道指示灯」变绿了。

examples.en: The cashier turned off the checkout light before taking a break.
examples.zh: 收银员去休息前关掉了「收银通道指示灯」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout lane intended for shoppers buying a small number of items

examples.en: I took my three notebooks to the express lane near the door.
examples.zh: 我拿着三本笔记本去了门边的「少量商品快结通道」。

examples.en: The express lane had a sign showing how many items it accepted.
examples.zh: 「少量商品快结通道」有块牌子，写着最多可以结几件商品。

collocations: a sign for the express lane

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of items accepted at a particular checkout

examples.en: I checked the item limit before taking my basket to the express lane.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「结账商品件数上限」，然后才提着篮子去快结通道。

examples.en: The item limit was printed on the sign above the checkout.
examples.zh: 「结账商品件数上限」印在收银台上方的标牌上。

collocations: an item limit for the express lane

words.enDefinition: a checkout rule admitting baskets and excluding shopping carts

examples.en: The sign said “Baskets only” above the smaller row of checkouts.
examples.zh: 较小的那排收银台上方写着「仅限手提篮结账」。

examples.en: I followed the “Baskets only” sign because I had just a few items.
examples.zh: 我只买了几件商品，就按「仅限手提篮结账」的牌子走。

words.enDefinition: a call for the next shopper in line to approach

examples.en: The cashier called, “Next customer, please,” after the previous shopper left.
examples.zh: 前一位顾客走后，收银员喊道「请下一位顾客」。

examples.en: I heard “Next customer, please” from the checkout beside the door.
examples.zh: 我听见门边的收银台传来「请下一位顾客」。

words.enDefinition: a moving surface that carries purchases toward the cashier

examples.en: I put my books on the checkout belt after the previous shopper.
examples.zh: 前面的顾客放好商品后，我把书放上了「收银传送带」。

examples.en: The checkout belt stopped after the cashier finished scanning the boxes.
examples.zh: 收银员扫完那些盒子后，「收银传送带」停了下来。

collocations: put groceries on the checkout belt

words.enDefinition: a bar separating one shopper's items from another's on the belt

examples.en: I used a checkout divider to separate my notebooks from another shopper's groceries.
examples.zh: 我用「收银传送带隔条」把自己的笔记本和另一位顾客的食品隔开。

examples.en: The cashier handed me a checkout divider when I set down my bag.
examples.zh: 我放下包时，收银员递给我一根「收银传送带隔条」。

collocations: place a checkout divider on the belt

words.enDefinition: to keep an item inside the cart while it is scanned

examples.en: Could I leave this in the cart while you scan the label?
examples.zh: 您扫标签时，我能「把这件留在购物车里」吗？

examples.en: The cashier said I could leave this in the cart because it was heavy.
examples.zh: 收银员说这件比较重，我可以「把它留在购物车里」。

collocations: can I leave this in the cart
please leave this in the cart
ask if I can leave this in the cart

words.enDefinition: a portable device used to read barcodes or other codes

examples.en: The cashier used a handheld scanner for the box in my cart.
examples.zh: 收银员用「手持扫描器」扫了我购物车里那个盒子的码。

examples.en: I found a handheld scanner attached to the side of the checkout.
examples.zh: 我发现收银设备侧面连着一个「手持扫描器」。

words.enDefinition: to enter items in a cash register and calculate what is owed

examples.en: The cashier offered to ring up the plates and towels together.
examples.zh: 收银员提出把盘子和毛巾一起「录入结账」。

examples.en: Could you ring up the notebooks before you scan the rest of the items?
examples.zh: 您能先把笔记本「录入结账」，再扫其他商品吗？

words.enDefinition: two or more purchases rung up and paid for separately

examples.en: We asked for separate transactions because the notebooks belonged to my roommate.
examples.zh: 那些笔记本是室友的，所以我们要求「分开结账」。

examples.en: The cashier processed separate transactions for my groceries and the club's supplies.
examples.zh: 收银员把我买的食品和社团用品「分开结账」。

collocations: ring items up in separate transactions

words.enDefinition: to use a reader to identify a product by its printed code

examples.en: The attendant asked me to scan the barcode on the back of the notebook.
examples.zh: 自助收银员叫我「扫笔记本背面的商品条码」。

examples.en: I couldn't scan the barcode because the sticker was partly folded.
examples.zh: 贴纸有一点折起来了，所以我没法「扫商品条码」。

collocations: ask staff to scan the barcode

words.enDefinition: the reader cannot identify the item from its code

examples.en: “The barcode won't scan,” I said when the cashier came over.
examples.zh: 收银员走过来时，我说「条码扫不出来」。

examples.en: My roommate said the barcode won't scan because the box was creased.
examples.zh: 室友说盒子折出了一道印，导致「条码扫不出来」。

collocations: “This barcode won't scan on the machine”
“The barcode won't scan even when I turn it over”

words.enDefinition: a question checking whether one item was recorded twice

examples.en: “Did that scan twice?” I asked after hearing two quick beeps.
examples.zh: 听到两声很近的提示音后，我问「刚才是不是扫了两次？」

examples.en: She looked at the item list and asked, “Did that scan twice?”
examples.zh: 她看了看商品列表，问「刚才是不是扫了两次？」

collocations: “Did that scan twice when you moved it?”

words.zhGloss: 取消一件已录入的商品
words.enDefinition: to remove a recorded item from the current sale
acceptedZhAnswers: 取消一件已录入的商品

examples.en: The cashier had to void an item after the scanner beeped twice.
examples.zh: 扫描器响了两次后，收银员只好「取消一件已录入的商品」。

examples.en: I asked whether she could void an item before I finished at the checkout.
examples.zh: 我问还没结完账，她能不能「取消一件已录入的商品」。

collocations: ask staff to void an item

words.enDefinition: to record how many units of the same item someone is buying

examples.en: The attendant showed me where to enter the quantity for identical notebooks.
examples.zh: 收银员指给我看，同款笔记本要在哪里「输入商品件数」。

examples.en: The screen asked me to enter the quantity before adding the items.
examples.zh: 屏幕在添加商品前要求我「输入商品件数」。

collocations: ask someone to enter the quantity

words.enDefinition: the area next to a checkout for scanned items

examples.en: I set the notebooks in the bagging area after scanning them.
examples.zh: 我扫完笔记本后，把它们放到「结账装袋区」。

examples.en: There wasn't much room in the bagging area for the larger box.
examples.zh: 「结账装袋区」没多少空间放那个大盒子。

collocations: put an item in the bagging area
an item left in the bagging area

words.expression: unexpected item in the bagging area
words.lemma: unexpected item in the bagging area
words.zhGloss: 装袋区发现未识别的物品
words.enDefinition: a machine message saying something placed near the bags was not expected
acceptedZhAnswers: 装袋区发现未识别的物品
acceptedEnVariants: unexpected item in the bagging area

examples.en: The display flashed “Unexpected item in the bagging area” when I put my bag down.
examples.zh: 我放下包时，屏幕闪出「装袋区发现未识别的物品」。

examples.en: I saw “Unexpected item in the bagging area” before an attendant came over.
examples.zh: 收银员过来之前，我看到「装袋区发现未识别的物品」的提示。

collocations: a warning saying “Unexpected item in the bagging area”
show “Unexpected item in the bagging area”
an “Unexpected item in the bagging area” message

words.enDefinition: a checkout option for an item placed outside the bagging area

examples.en: I saw a “Skip bagging” option beside the picture of the large box.
examples.zh: 我在大盒子的图片旁看到了「跳过装袋」的选项。

examples.en: The attendant pointed out “Skip bagging” on the screen beside my shopping.
examples.zh: 收银员指给我看，屏幕上、我的商品旁边有「跳过装袋」。

words.enDefinition: confirmation by staff before a self-service transaction can continue

examples.en: The screen asked for attendant approval after I removed the duplicate item.
examples.zh: 我去掉重复录入的商品后，屏幕提示「需收银员确认」。

examples.en: I paused at the checkout when the display showed “Attendant approval required.”
examples.zh: 屏幕显示「需收银员确认」时，我在收银台停了下来。

words.enDefinition: to ask the staff member supervising a checkout to come over

examples.en: The screen said to call the attendant if the barcode couldn't be read.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示，如果读不出条码，就「呼叫自助区店员」。

examples.en: I asked whether I should call the attendant before moving the box.
examples.zh: 我问挪动盒子之前要不要先「呼叫自助区店员」。

collocations: press the button to call the attendant

words.enDefinition: a device that prints the paper record of a sale

examples.en: The receipt printer made a noise before the paper came out.
examples.zh: 收据出来前，「收据打印机」响了一声。

examples.en: The cashier changed the roll in the receipt printer next to the till.
examples.zh: 收银员换了收银台旁「收据打印机」里的纸卷。

collocations: replace a roll in the receipt printer
a receipt printer beside the register

words.enDefinition: a checkout instruction to collect your printed proof of payment

examples.en: The screen displayed “Take your receipt” before returning to the first page.
examples.zh: 屏幕回到首页前显示「请取走收据」。

examples.en: I heard “Take your receipt” while I was putting away my wallet.
examples.zh: 我在收钱包时听到「请取走收据」的提示。

collocations: a reminder to take your receipt

words.enDefinition: a bag made of paper for carrying purchases

examples.en: The clerk offered me a paper carrier bag for the notebooks.
examples.zh: 店员提出用「纸质手提袋」给我装笔记本。

examples.en: I carried the two mugs home in a small paper carrier bag.
examples.zh: 我用一个小「纸质手提袋」把两个马克杯提回了家。

collocations: a paper carrier bag with handles

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a shopper wants a bag for the purchase

examples.en: The cashier asked, “Do you need a bag?” as I packed my wallet away.
examples.zh: 我收起钱包时，收银员问「你需要袋子吗？」

examples.en: “Do you need a bag?” she asked after scanning the last notebook.
examples.zh: 她扫完最后一本笔记本后问「你需要袋子吗？」

collocations: “Do you need a bag for that?”
“Do you need a bag for the books?”

words.enDefinition: to hand over an item without putting it in a bag

examples.en: Could you leave it unbagged so I can carry it by the handle?
examples.zh: 可以「不用给它装袋」吗？我能直接提着把手走。

examples.en: I asked her to leave it unbagged because it fitted in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我请她「不用给它装袋」，因为它放得进我的背包。

collocations: ask someone to leave it unbagged

words.enDefinition: an offer to put your own purchases into bags

examples.en: “I'll bag these myself,” I said as I took out my reusable bag.
examples.zh: 我掏出自己的环保袋，说「这些我自己装袋」。

examples.en: My roommate told the cashier, “I'll bag these myself,” and moved to the side.
examples.zh: 室友跟收银员说「这些我自己装袋」，然后挪到一边。

collocations: “I'll bag these myself while you scan”

words.enDefinition: a tag attached to goods to help prevent theft at a store

examples.en: The cashier noticed the security tag as she folded the jacket.
examples.zh: 收银员折夹克时注意到了上面的「商品防盗标签」。

examples.en: I showed the receipt after finding a security tag still on my coat.
examples.zh: 我发现大衣上还有「商品防盗标签」，就出示了收据。

collocations: a jacket with a security tag

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether the hanger is included with the purchase

examples.en: “Can I keep the hanger?” I asked after choosing the interview jacket.
examples.zh: 我选好面试穿的夹克后问「这个衣架我能留下吗？」

examples.en: I pointed at the skirt and asked, “Can I keep the hanger?”
examples.zh: 我指了指那条裙子问「这个衣架我能留下吗？」

collocations: “Can I keep the hanger with this jacket?”
“Can I keep the hanger as well?”

words.enDefinition: a service for ordering online and collecting from a shop
acceptedEnVariants: buy online, pick up in store

examples.en: I used click and collect because the shop was near my seminar room.
examples.zh: 店就在研讨课教室附近，我就选了「线上下单门店自提」。

examples.en: The retailer offered click and collect for the lamp I was looking at.
examples.zh: 我看的那款台灯，零售商支持「线上下单门店自提」。

words.enDefinition: a service that sets an item aside for purchase in person

examples.en: I chose reserve and collect so I could look at the jacket first.
examples.zh: 我选了「线上预留到店取货」，这样可以先看一下夹克。

examples.en: The shop's reserve and collect page let me choose a branch near campus.
examples.zh: 店家的「线上预留到店取货」页面让我选了学校附近的门店。

words.enDefinition: to choose the store where your order is to be collected

examples.en: I had to select a pickup store before reaching the last page.
examples.zh: 我得先「选择自提门店」，才能进入最后一页。

examples.en: The site asked me to select a pickup store from the map.
examples.zh: 网站让我在地图上「选择自提门店」。

collocations: select a pickup store near you
select a pickup store at checkout
be asked to select a pickup store

words.enDefinition: an option to collect an order on the day it is placed

examples.en: I checked whether the desk lamp was available for same-day pickup on Friday.
examples.zh: 我查了那盏台灯周五能不能「当日自提」。

examples.en: The app offered same-day pickup before I entered my payment details.
examples.zh: 我还没输入付款信息，应用就显示可以「当日自提」。

collocations: an item available for same-day pickup

words.enDefinition: details explaining where and how to collect an order

examples.en: I checked the pickup instructions because the shop had two separate entrances.
examples.zh: 这家店有两个入口，我就看了下「自提说明」。

examples.en: The pickup instructions gave the name of the shopping centre's side entrance.
examples.zh: 「自提说明」里写了商场侧面入口的名称。

words.enDefinition: to notify staff you have arrived to collect an order

examples.en: I opened the app to check in for pickup outside the shop.
examples.zh: 我在店外打开应用，「登记自己已到店自提」。

examples.en: The sign asked customers to check in for pickup before joining the queue.
examples.zh: 标牌请顾客先「登记已到店自提」，再去排队。

collocations: check in for pickup at the store
use the app to check in for pickup
be asked to check in for pickup

words.enDefinition: a marked parking space for customers collecting store orders

examples.en: I parked in a pickup bay and waited for the attendant to arrive.
examples.zh: 我把车停进一个「自提专用停车位」，等店员过来。

examples.en: My roommate read the number painted on the pickup bay near the entrance.
examples.zh: 室友读了入口附近「自提专用停车位」地面上漆的号码。

words.expression: bring it out to the car
words.lemma: bring it out to the car
words.enDefinition: to carry the purchase outside to the customer's car
acceptedEnVariants: bring it out to the car

examples.en: I asked whether someone could bring it out to the car after class.
examples.zh: 我问下课后来取时，能不能请店员「把货拿到车边」。

examples.en: The assistant offered to bring it out to the car once it was packed.
examples.zh: 店员说装好后可以「把货拿到车边」。

collocations: ask someone to bring it out to the car
offer to bring it out to the car
could you bring it out to the car

words.enDefinition: a machine where customers can check in to collect orders

examples.en: The collection kiosk was opposite the doors near the covered car park.
examples.zh: 「取货自助终端」在有顶棚的停车场旁、那两扇门对面。

examples.en: I asked an assistant how to find my order on the collection kiosk.
examples.zh: 我问店员，怎么在「取货自助终端」上查看我的订单。

collocations: check in at a collection kiosk

words.enDefinition: to present a barcode used to identify an order at pickup

examples.en: The notice said to show your pickup barcode at the side counter.
examples.zh: 通知说要在侧面的柜台「出示取货条码」。

examples.en: “Please show your pickup barcode,” the assistant said when I reached the counter.
examples.zh: 我到柜台时，店员说「请出示取货条码」。

collocations: show your pickup barcode on your phone
be asked to show your pickup barcode

words.enDefinition: to present the message sent about collecting an order

examples.en: I was asked to show the pickup email when I reached the counter.
examples.zh: 我到柜台时，店员请我「出示自提邮件」。

examples.en: The assistant said I could show the pickup email on my phone.
examples.zh: 店员说我可以在手机上「出示自提邮件」。

collocations: ask someone to show the pickup email
show the pickup email on your phone
be ready to show the pickup email

words.enDefinition: a named person other than the buyer who may collect the order

examples.en: I added my roommate as the alternate pickup person before placing the order.
examples.zh: 下单前，我把室友添加为「代取人」。

examples.en: The order page let me change the alternate pickup person after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在订单页面更换了「代取人」。

words.expression: pick up at a different branch
words.lemma: pick up at a different branch
words.enDefinition: to collect an order at a store location other than the original choice
acceptedEnVariants: pick up at a different branch

examples.en: Can I pick up at a different branch closer to my new flat?
examples.zh: 我能「换一家离新住处更近的门店自提」吗？

examples.en: I asked whether I could pick up at a different branch that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚能不能「换一家门店自提」。

collocations: ask to pick up at a different branch
arrange to pick up at a different branch
choose to pick up at a different branch

words.enDefinition: collection of only part of an order now, with the rest collected later

examples.en: I asked about a partial pickup because only the notebook was ready.
examples.zh: 因为只有笔记本准备好了，我问能不能「部分商品先自提」。

examples.en: The partial pickup left the desk lamp listed as a separate collection.
examples.zh: 「部分商品先自提」后，台灯仍单独列为待取货。

words.enDefinition: to keep an item apart from regular stock for someone to collect

examples.en: The assistant said the books were set aside for collection behind the counter.
examples.zh: 店员说，那些书「已留货待取」，放在柜台后。

examples.en: The chair had been set aside for collection by the midday shift.
examples.zh: 中午当班的店员已经把椅子放到「留货待取」的位置。

collocations: a parcel set aside for collection
get an order set aside for collection

words.enDefinition: an order still at the shop after its expected collection

examples.en: The shop called about an uncollected order I had placed the previous week.
examples.zh: 店家打电话问我上周那笔「未取走的订单」。

examples.en: I saw an uncollected order from last month when I checked the app.
examples.zh: 我查看应用时，看到上个月有一笔「未取走的订单」。

collocations: follow up on an uncollected order
a reminder about an uncollected order
an uncollected order at the store

words.expression: where do I collect online orders
words.lemma: where do i collect online orders
words.enDefinition: a question asking where a shop hands over online purchases
acceptedEnVariants: where do I collect online orders

examples.en: I saw several desks and asked, “Where do I collect online orders?”
examples.zh: 我看到好几个柜台，便问「网上订单到哪儿取？」

examples.en: “Where do I collect online orders?” my friend asked the attendant by the stairs.
examples.zh: 朋友问楼梯旁的店员「网上订单到哪儿取？」

collocations: ask “Where do I collect online orders?”
“Where do I collect online orders at this store?”
“Where do I collect online orders after six?”

words.enDefinition: a decorative box used to present an item as a gift

examples.en: The assistant found a gift box large enough for both of the mugs.
examples.zh: 店员找了个能装下两个马克杯的「礼品盒」。

examples.en: I chose a plain gift box because I had a ribbon at home.
examples.zh: 我家里有丝带，就选了个素色「礼品盒」。

collocations: put an item in a gift box

words.enDefinition: a decorative bag used to present a gift

examples.en: I asked for a gift bag after choosing the scarf for my friend.
examples.zh: 我给朋友挑好围巾后，要了一个「礼品袋」。

examples.en: The clerk brought a small gift bag that fit the notebook perfectly.
examples.zh: 店员拿来一个小「礼品袋」，刚好能装那本笔记本。

collocations: put a present in a gift bag

words.enDefinition: a tag attached to a gift for a name or short message

examples.en: The clerk left the gift tag blank so I could write it later.
examples.zh: 店员把「礼物吊牌」留空，让我回去自己写。

examples.en: I wrote my roommate's name on the gift tag at the counter.
examples.zh: 我在柜台把室友的名字写在「礼物吊牌」上。

collocations: write a name on a gift tag

words.enDefinition: thin, soft paper used to wrap or cushion an item

examples.en: She put blue tissue paper around the scarf before closing the box.
examples.zh: 她合上盒子前，用蓝色「薄页包装纸」包好了围巾。

examples.en: I asked whether they had tissue paper to go inside the gift bag.
examples.zh: 我问他们有没有能放在礼品袋里的「薄页包装纸」。

collocations: use tissue paper in a gift box

words.enDefinition: decorative paper used to cover a present

examples.en: I chose green wrapping paper for the book we bought our tutor.
examples.zh: 我们买了本书送导师，我选了绿色的「礼品包装纸」。

examples.en: The assistant cut a piece of wrapping paper to fit the box.
examples.zh: 店员裁了一张大小适合盒子的「礼品包装纸」。

collocations: cover a box in wrapping paper

words.expression: can you leave the price off
words.lemma: can you leave the price off
words.enDefinition: a request to remove visible pricing before giving a gift
acceptedEnVariants: can you leave the price off

examples.en: I bought the scarf for a friend and asked, “Can you leave the price off?”
examples.zh: 围巾是给朋友买的，我便问「能把价格去掉吗？」

examples.en: “Can you leave the price off?” she asked before the clerk wrapped it.
examples.zh: 店员打包前，她问「能把价格去掉吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you leave the price off?”
“Can you leave the price off the gift?”
“Can you leave the price off the tag?”

words.enDefinition: to put a decorative strip around a parcel or gift box

examples.en: Could you add a ribbon to the box before I collect it?
examples.zh: 我来取之前，能给盒子「加一条装饰丝带」吗？

examples.en: The assistant offered to add a ribbon that matched the wrapping paper.
examples.zh: 店员提出「加一条和包装纸相配的装饰丝带」。

collocations: add a ribbon to the gift box
ask someone to add a ribbon

words.enDefinition: to put several purchases in the same gift wrapping

examples.en: Could you wrap these together so I can give them as one gift?
examples.zh: 能「把这几样包在一起」吗？我想当成一份礼物送人。

examples.en: I asked the clerk to wrap these together with the matching card.
examples.zh: 我请店员「把这几样和配套卡片包在一起」。

collocations: ask someone to wrap these together
wrap these together in one box
could you wrap these together as one gift

words.enDefinition: to place separate wrapping around every item instead of combining them

examples.en: Could you wrap each one individually so the two cups don't knock together?
examples.zh: 能「每件单独包起来」吗？这样两只杯子就不会相碰。

examples.en: I asked the assistant to wrap each one individually before putting them in the bag.
examples.zh: 我请店员先「每件单独包起来」，再把它们装进袋子。

collocations: ask staff to wrap each one individually
wrap each one individually in paper
could you wrap each one individually

words.enDefinition: material placed around an item to protect it from damage

examples.en: The clerk added protective wrapping around the corners of the picture frame.
examples.zh: 店员在相框的几个角外加了「防护包装」。

examples.en: I asked for protective wrapping because the glass bowl had no box.
examples.zh: 那个玻璃碗没有盒子，所以我请店员加一些「防护包装」。

words.enDefinition: a handle attached to a box or package to lift it

examples.en: The clerk added a carry handle so I could take the box home.
examples.zh: 店员加了个「提手」，方便我把盒子拿回家。

examples.en: I asked whether the kettle box had a carry handle on top.
examples.zh: 我问水壶的包装盒顶上有没有「提手」。

collocations: a box with a carry handle

words.enDefinition: a store counter where purchases can be wrapped as gifts

examples.en: I took the books to the gift wrap counter after paying for them.
examples.zh: 我结完书钱，把书拿到「礼品包装柜台」。

examples.en: The gift wrap counter had three rolls of paper to choose from.
examples.zh: 「礼品包装柜台」有三卷包装纸可选。

collocations: go to the gift wrap counter
ask at the gift wrap counter
a line at the gift wrap counter
